details: The cryptocurrency market is experiencing a significant downturn, with Bitcoin falling below $62,000, reaching levels last seen before the US-Iran conflict. This slide has been exacerbated by nearly $1.5 billion in long positions liquidated across the crypto market within 24 hours. Spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded their 11th consecutive day of net outflows, totaling approximately $3.83 billion since May, draining assets under management. Ethereum and other altcoins have also seen sharp declines, amplifying Bitcoin's weakness.
title: Crypto Market Plummets Amid Extensive Liquidations and ETF Outflows

details: The appointment of Kevin Warsh as the new Federal Reserve Chair, known for his hawkish stance, has signaled an accelerated tightening monetary policy, negatively impacting risk-on assets like cryptocurrencies. Broader macroeconomic concerns, including sustained high-interest rates, inflation squeezing consumers, and geopolitical tensions, are prompting institutional investors to pull liquidity from volatile positions and seek safer yields. The OECD has also reportedly slashed its global growth forecast.
title: Hawkish Fed Stance and Macroeconomic Headwinds Dampen Crypto

details: Institutional capital is reportedly rotating away from cryptocurrencies and into AI-related equities, which are currently setting fresh all-time highs. This shift is seen as a "painful metamorphosis" for crypto, moving from a momentum trade to a contrarian bet. Adding to the bearish sentiment, MicroStrategy made its first Bitcoin sale since 2022, offloading 32 BTC for approximately $2.5 million, a move seen as a symbolic institutional retreat despite its small scale relative to their total holdings.
title: Institutional Capital Rotates to AI, MicroStrategy Sells Bitcoin

details: Despite the current market downturn, traditional financial institutions are expanding their crypto offerings. Charles Schwab has introduced 24/7 cryptocurrency futures trading services, covering Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and XRP futures. Additionally, Coinbase is set to launch SpaceX Pre-IPO perpetual contracts, and prediction market platform Kalshi has also launched Bitcoin perpetual futures. This indicates a growing integration of crypto assets into mainstream financial products.
title: Traditional Finance Embraces Crypto Futures Amid Market Volatility
